newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia to cut cheque clearing time.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia to cut cheque clearing time.

text.p: Bank Negara Malaysia will implement a system next year to reduce the clearing time for out of town cheques to a maximum five days from up to 14 days at present.
The new system, which would improve efficiency, would be implemented in three phases beginning next year, Bank Negara governor Ahmad Mohd Don told an annual conference with bank chief executives.
A statement from Bank Negara said that the guidelines on minimum standards for internal auditors of financial institutions had also been drafted.
The new guidelines for internal auditors will be implemented from January next year.
